verdict.headline: No trade today
verdict.reason: Still no trade at 6:40am PT. After CAD CPI, USD/CAD broke above 1.4291, pulled back to it, held, and pushed to 1.4303. Price is now 1.4299, stuck in a 4-pip band under 1.4303 resistance, so there's no room to a target. USD/JPY, GBP/USD and USD/CHF are unchanged from the 5:15am plan. No new USD entries until Fed Chair Warsh speaks at 9:00am PT.

watchlist.missing: Long break of 1.4291: the 5:30am CPI candle closed well above it with displacement, and price followed through to about 1.4305 and broke M5 structure. It then pulled back to about 1.4290–1.4293 and held, with bullish candles back up. The EMA 20 (1.4295) is above the EMA 50 (1.4290) with price above both, and RSI is 58 (read on M5). That retest has already played out, though. Price is 1.4299, only 4 pips under 1.4303 resistance, which has rejected twice (wicks to about 1.4306 and 1.4304). Buying here can't reach 1:2. Bodies have closed both sides of 1.4299, so that line isn't a clean break either. New USD entries are blocked until Warsh at 9:00am PT.

Short break of 159.70: there's a close below, follow-through, and a retest to about 159.72 that was rejected with a strong bearish candle. The EMA 20 is below the EMA 50 with price below both, and RSI is 47 (room for a short). M5 isn't in the screenshot, so the structure break is unconfirmed (5/6). The retest entry (about 159.68) has already played out, and price is now 159.51. Selling here with the SL above the retest swing (about 159.76) and TP at 159.34 is under 1:1. US data at 5:30am PT and Warsh at 9:00am PT block it.

Price is 1.3198, between 1.3221 resistance and 1.3183 support, with no break of either. It's sitting on the EMA 20/50 with RSI 53, so there's no direction. A trade needs a displacement close through one level, an M5 structure break and a retest with a candle trigger. The other level is the TP, and the 38-pip range only gives 1:2 with a tight retest stop.

Price is 0.8392, between 0.8409 resistance and 0.8386 support. The overnight drop stopped at 0.8387 without a body close below the level. The EMA 20 is below the EMA 50 with price below both, and RSI is 42. A short needs a displacement close below 0.8386 and a retest from underneath with a trigger, plus a support marked below for TP.

newsBlocks: Released: 5:30am PT CAD CPI and US Empire State. USD/CAD broke above 1.4291 on the release. That pair isn't blocked by them any more, but every setup still has to pass the rules.
9:00am PT Fed Chair Warsh speaks: no new entries on any USD pair (all 7 majors) before it. After it, a setup can requalify only if the break-and-retest still holds.
watchFor: USD/CAD (after 9:00am PT): a fresh pullback to 1.4291–1.4293 that holds, with a bullish engulfing or pin bar. Roughly: entry about 1.4292, SL about 1.4287 (2–3 pips under the swing low), TP 1.4303, which is about 1:2.2. Only if RSI is under 70 and the EMA 20 is still above the EMA 50. Or a displacement body close above 1.4303 and a retest from above. Please mark the next resistance above 1.4303 so there's a target to check.
USD/JPY: a fresh pullback to 159.70 that rejects with a bearish engulfing or pin bar and an M5 structure break, with RSI above 30. TP 159.34 gives 1:2+ if the SL is tight above the retest swing.
GBP/USD: a displacement close through 1.3221 or 1.3183, then a retest with a trigger.
USD/CHF: a body close below 0.8386 with displacement, then a retest from underneath. Please mark a support below.
